evals.prompt: Build a landing page for a developer tools SaaS that monitors API performance. Make it look nothing like every other SaaS landing page.
evals.expected_output: Must commit to a BOLD aesthetic direction and state it explicitly before generating code (e.g. 'editorial/industrial' or 'brutalist minimal'). Must choose a distinctive font pairing — not Inter, Roboto, Arial. Must use oklch or color-mix for palette. Must avoid AI slop fingerprints: no purple-to-blue gradients, no cyan glow accents on dark, no rounded cards with thick colored left border, no hero metric layout (big number + small label + gradient accent), no glassmorphism. Must use fluid spacing with clamp(). Must identify one memorable differentiator. Design should pass the AI Slop Test — look intentionally authored, not template fill-in.
assertions: States a clear aesthetic direction before generating code
Does not use Inter, Roboto, Arial, or system defaults
Uses oklch or modern CSS color functions
Avoids purple-to-blue gradients and cyan glow accents
Does not use identical card grid (icon + heading + text repeated)
Does not use the hero metric layout cliche
Uses fluid spacing with clamp()
Identifies one memorable differentiator for the design

evals.prompt: Create an analytics dashboard with a dark theme for monitoring real-time server metrics (CPU, memory, requests/sec, error rate).
evals.expected_output: Must commit to a specific dark aesthetic — not default dark mode with glowing accents. Neutrals must be tinted, not pure #000. Must use container queries (@container) for responsive panels. Must add one considered motion moment (staggered panel load) using transform/opacity only — not width/height/padding. Must design an empty state that teaches (e.g. 'Connect your first server to see metrics'). Must NOT use cyan/purple glow accents. Must avoid nested cards. Data hierarchy must be clear without gradient text.
assertions: Commits to a specific dark aesthetic, not generic glow-on-black
Tints neutrals with a brand hue (not pure black)
Uses container queries for panel responsiveness
Adds one entry animation using transform/opacity only
Designs a meaningful empty state
Avoids cyan/purple glow accents
Avoids nested cards
Does not use gradient text for metrics or headings

evals.prompt: Make a conference poster for a talk titled 'The Hidden Cost of Hydration' about React Server Components performance.
evals.expected_output: Must choose a strong typographic or visual concept and state it. Must use a distinctive font pairing — not monospace as a developer aesthetic shortcut. Must avoid generic stock-photo + headline layout. Must use a limited cohesive palette (dominant + sharp accent, not 3 equal-weight colors). Must not use rounded rectangles with generic drop shadows. Should have an unexpected composition or typographic choice that makes it memorable. Layout should use intentional asymmetry — not center-everything. Design should feel like a deliberate artifact, not a template fill-in.
assertions: States a typographic or visual concept for the poster
Uses a distinctive font pairing (not monospace as developer shortcut)
Avoids generic stock-photo + headline layout
Uses a limited palette (dominant + accent, not 3 equal colors)
Avoids rounded rectangles with generic drop shadows
Uses asymmetric composition intentionally
Has one memorable or unexpected design choice
